messages: mona: quick thought — trace viewer header micro-change. proposal: move correlation-id pill next to trace title so it's visible on arrival, and make Copy the first action (people paste ids fast). short mock attached. alex: agree on proximity. accessibility concern: we currently show `Corr ID`; should we expose full `Correlation ID` for clarity? might break layout at <800px. jean: prefer visual brevity + SR clarity. suggest visible `Corr. ID · 7a3f2b` with `aria-label="Correlation ID: 7a3f2b"`. example: `Corr. ID · 7a3f2b`. mona: designbot run contrast check? current pill text #1f2d5a on #eef2ff. designbot: contrast result: 3.9:1 (fails AA normal text). Recommend darker text #0f1b3a or bolder weight. sam: keyboard order needs to be title -> pill -> copy -> download. currently pill is after actions. small DOM reorder will fix. taylor: DOM reorder ok but note analytics toolbar is a separate region; will mark pill as part of header (aria-describedby) and keep toolbar grouping. will send PR for markup + tab order. alex: about CTAs: make Copy first and visually prominent (filled). Download as outline. change aria-labels to `Copy correlation id to clipboard` and `Download trace (har/json)` for clarity. jean: I'll push a narrow-width mock and update tokens: pill bg darker and text weight increased. also reduce horizontal padding to fit `Corr. ID` at small widths. mona: sweet. summary: move pill into title row, pill visual `Corr. ID · id` with SR `Correlation ID: id`, increase contrast, reorder CTAs to [Copy (primary), Download]. no blockers? sam: no blockers. I'll update runbook steps where we instruct support to click Download -> Copy. mona: thanks everyone — planning to ship in next minor release.
